Description:
Inability to recover debts from our
customers in full
Mitigating actions:
• Periodic review of the credit policy and strict
enforcement of credit terms; and
• Continuous monitoring of debtor performance
and follow up.

reporting risks
Description:
Failure to meet various accounting and
reporting requirements under IFRS
- IFRS 16 Leases
- IFRS 9 Financial Instruments
- IFRS 15 Revenue from contracts with
customers
- IAS 1 Presentation of fi nancial
statements
Mitigating actions:
• Continuously seeking professional advice on
technical matters; and
• Development and upskilling of staff through
training.

Risk:

Description:
Possible disruption in the supply of
essential goods and services
Mitigating actions:
• Use of multiple vendors for essential supplies
of goods and services; and
• Rigorous vetting process for vendors.

Description:
Misappropriation or misuse of assets
belong to the Group by staff and external
stakeholders
Mitigating actions:
• Strict enforcement of the Code of Business
Conduct;
• Fraud awareness programs focusing of
preventive measures; and
• Whistleblowing mechanisms.
